title: HTTP Security Headers
description: Essential HTTP security headers every web app should set — CSP, HSTS, CORS, and anti-XSS protections.

entries.label: Content-Security-Policy
entries.command: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:;
entries.description: Control which resources the browser can load — strongest XSS defense

entries.label: Strict-Transport-Security
entries.description: Force HTTPS for 2 years, include subdomains, and opt-in to browser preload list

entries.label: X-Content-Type-Options
entries.description: Prevent MIME type sniffing — browser must respect Content-Type header

entries.label: X-Frame-Options
entries.description: Prevent your site from being embedded in iframes — blocks clickjacking

entries.label: Referrer-Policy
entries.description: Send full referrer for same-origin, only origin for cross-origin requests

entries.label: Permissions-Policy
entries.description: Control which browser features your site can use — disable camera, mic, payment

entries.label: CORS Headers
entries.command:
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.example.com
Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type
Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400
entries.description: Configure Cross-Origin Resource Sharing — never use * in production with credentials

entries.label: Cookie Security
entries.command: Set-Cookie: session=abc123; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=86400
entries.description: Secure cookie attributes — HttpOnly prevents JS access, SameSite prevents CSRF

entries.label: Check Your Headers
entries.description: Quick audit of security headers on any website
